newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sommer seeks no further rise in Tarkett stake.
newsitem.headline: Sommer seeks no further rise in Tarkett stake.

text.p: French plastics group Sommer Allibert does not intend to increase its stake in German floor coverings manufacturer Tarkett AG beyond the level of 50 percent it will eventually hold after a warrant bond issue has been exercised, Tarkett said on Wednesday.
"They have no intention to go up, it's part of the agreement, they will stay at 50 percent," Tarkett chief executive Lars Wisen told a presentation in Frankfurt.
Earlier on Wednesday, Tarkett and Sommer Allibert announced they were merging their floor coverings businesses in a move which will initially involve Sommer acquiring a 60 percent stake in Tarkett.

That stake will be diluted to 50 percent after warrants have been exercised on a bond which Tarkett plans to issue to help finance the deal. Tarkett will pay Sommer 705 million marks in cash for Sommer's floor coverings business.
